description: This file defines the CategoryRepository class, which interacts with an ApiService to fetch various categories of content items such as trending, action, comedy, etc. It provides methods to fetch categories from the network with fallback to sample data in case of failures.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class that fetches content categories from network with fallback to sample data.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates a list of sample ContentItem objects for a given HomeCategory used as fallback data when network requests fail.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches a list of ContentItems for a specified HomeCategory from the network; falls back to sample data upon errors.
